source.title: Classifying PL 4-manifolds via crystallizations: results and open problems

trace.notes: Resolved the zbMATH page as a bibliographic record for the exact work titled 'Classifying PL 4-manifolds via crystallizations: results and open problems' by Maria Rita Casali, Paola Cristofori, and Carlo Gagliardi, but did not obtain a readable full-text PDF or HTML source for extraction.

OpenAlex identified the exact-work repository copy and the IRIS UNIMORE OAI ORE/DIDL records exposed exact bitstream URLs for the PDF and extracted text. However, the OpenAlex content URL returned HTTP 401, the IRIS bitstream and text URLs returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenges, the handle landing page also returned HTTP 403, and browser fallback was unavailable in this environment because the Playwright Chrome runtime was not installed.
